一只受惊的猫在五英里的路程中幸存了下来在发动机盖下来回穿梭开车送孩子上学。
A terrified cat has survived a five mile round trip under the engine cover of a car on a school run.
人们发现那只黑猫蜷缩在……大卫·金的汽车引擎盖他决定之后做一次机油检查。送孙子去肯特郡上学。
The black cat was found curled up under the engine cover of David King's car when he decided to do an oil check after dropping his grandson off at school in Kent.
金先生的妻子说她丈夫来了跑进来，大声喊我过来看看。
Mr. King's wife said her husband had come running in and was shouting for me to come have a look.
我们甚至都不确定它是否还活着，所以我用棍子轻轻地把它推了下去检查它是否还在呼吸，发现它……一只吓坏了的小猫。
We weren't even sure it was alive, so I gently pushed it with a stick to check it was breathing and saw it was a terrified little cat.
它甚至倒退得更远，钻进了发动机里。卡住了。
It reversed even further into the engine and was stuck.
我试图够到它，但它……太深了，已经没有办法了。我可以把它弄出来。
I tried to reach it, but it was too far down and there wasn't any way I could get it out.
在英国慈善机构“猫咪保护协会”的救助下，这只四岁的猫后来与主人团聚了。和它的主人，金先生的邻居。
Following a rescue by UK charity Cat's Protection, the four year old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr. King's neighbor.
新闻报道有两篇。
News reports two.
不到一个月的时间，特殊奥林匹克运动会春季运动会将重返费耶特维尔。
In less than a month, the Special Olympics Spring Games will make a return to Fayetteville.
奥运会即将回归，迎来第一届。五年后的时间。
The Games are coming back for the first time in five years.
活动将在卫理公会大学举行。
The event will take place at Methodist University.
活动组织者本杰明·科瓦尔奇克表示，他对此感到兴奋。运动员将有机会重返赛场。并展示他们的能力。
Event organizer, Benjamin Kowalczyk, says he's excited that athletes will get a chance to come back and demonstrate their abilities.
组织者预计将有大约一百名运动员参加。前往费耶特维尔参赛。
Organizers expect about a hundred athletes will come out to compete in Fayetteville.
他们将举办各种各样的活动可选择的运动包括跑步、投掷和跳跃。
They will have a variety of events to choose from, including running, throwing, and jumping.
还会有一个有趣的帐篷孩子们。
There will also be a fun tent for children.
科瓦尔奇克表示，看到运动员们……令人欣慰。特殊需求群体在奥运会上取得胜利。
Kowalczyk said it's rewarding to see athletes with special needs triumph in the Games.
任何想参与制作的人都可以考虑。今年的奥运会取得了巨大的成功，但仍有……有机会成为费耶特维尔特殊奥林匹克运动会的志愿者。
For anyone who wants to help make this year's Games a massive success, there are still opportunities to volunteer for Fayetteville's Special Olympics.
组织者鼓励他们访问奥运会网站。注册。
Organizers encourage them to visit the Games website to sign up.
这家瑞士公司辩称，其镀金的巧克力兔子理应受到版权保护，免受类似作品的侵害。这家廉价超市出售的产品。
The Swiss firm had argued its gold-wrapped chocolate rabbit deserved copyright protection from a similar product sold by the budget supermarket.
瑞士最高法院同意了这一观点，并推翻了之前的裁决。去年，该国商业法庭裁定：站在了超市一边。
Switzerland's highest court agreed and overturned a ruling last year by the country's commercial court that had sided with the supermarket.
它下令所有仿制兔子……虽然巧克力被毁了，但他建议不必浪费。
It ordered that all the imitation rabbits be destroyed, but suggested the chocolate needn't be wasted.
它可以熔化后用于其他用途。产品。
It could be melted for use in other products.
它说，尽管存在一些差异。这两种产品之间仍然存在着……可能导致消费者混淆。
It said even though there are some differences between the two products, there was still the possibility of confusion for consumers.
瑞士制造商的兔子系着一个红色蝴蝶结还有铃铛，而德国超市则有绿色蝴蝶结和铃铛。
The Swiss manufacturer's rabbit has a red bow and bell, while the German supermarket's has a green bow and bell.
包装纸的颜色也相似，因为这些是各项功能的图示。
The color of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
这家巧克力公司之前就上过法庭。为了保护其广受欢迎的巧克力产品。
The chocolate company has been to court before to protect its popular chocolate treat.
去年，德国联邦法院表示金色包装的色泽也得到了保护。
Last year, a German federal court said the shade of the gold wrapping was also protected.
